title: Lumière Play
description: A cinema inside Minecraft. Watch YouTube, Twitch and local videos on a virtual screen in your world.
body:
![Lumière Play — in-game cinema mod for Minecraft](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jrxmod/lumiereplay/master/gallery/banner.png) # 🎬 Lumière Play You build a theatre. Place a projector. Paste a YouTube link — and a screen appears on your wall, playing the video. With sound. In real time. Everyone nearby sees and hears the same thing. That is the whole mod. --- ## 🍿 Getting started Craft the projector, place it facing a wall, right-click — and you are in. Pick quality, screen size, hit Play.
📦 Crafting recipe | | | | |---|---|---| | Glass Pane | Glass Pane | Glass Pane | | Iron Ingot | Diamond | Iron Ingot | | Iron Ingot | Redstone | Iron Ingot |
--- ## 🌐 What you can watch **YouTube · Twitch · Vimeo · VK · Rutube · Dailymotion · SoundCloud · local files** Quality: Best / 1080p / 720p / 480p / 360p Screen ratios: 16:9 — 32:18 — 21:9 — 4:3 --- ## 🖥️ Multiplayer Works on servers out of the box. The server needs nothing extra — all playback is client-side. Everyone in range watches together. --- ## ⚙️ Requirements Just **VLC Media Player** — the mod uses it for video decoding.
How to install VLC Linux
sudo pacman -S vlc or sudo apt install vlc

Windows
Download at https://www.videolan.org/vlc/

macOS
brew install vlc
yt-dlp downloads itself automatically if it is not on your system. Nothing to do. --- ## 🌍 Languages English and Russian built in. --- [Source code](https://github.com/jrxmod/lumiereplay) · Apache 2.0 · by jrxmod
